findings.title: No test file covers /api/admin upload route
findings.evidence: grep -rl upload tests/ -> only tests/unit/bale-bot.test.ts (unrelated); no tests/api/upload*.test.ts exists; ls tests/api shows 26 suites, none target upload.ts
findings.suggested_fix: Add tests/api/upload.test.ts covering auth/admin gating, file-type and size validation, and rejection paths.

findings.title: No test file targets the coupons-active route
findings.evidence: grep -rl 'coupons-active' tests/ -> empty output; coupons.test.ts covers /api/coupons/validate and admin coupon CRUD but not coupons-active.ts
findings.suggested_fix: Add a test for GET active-coupons listing (active/expiry filtering, no leaking of discountValue internals if public).

findings.title: Blog API route has no direct API test
findings.evidence: grep -rl blog tests/ -> tests/unit/blog-json-ld.test.ts, tests/api/sitemap.test.ts, tests/api/breadcrumbs.test.ts (JSON-LD/sitemap/breadcrumb only); no tests/api/blog.test.ts exercising blog.ts endpoints directly
findings.suggested_fix: Add tests/api/blog.test.ts for blog list/detail endpoints (pagination, slug lookup, 404 path).

findings.title: Fragile add-to-cart selector based on generic button+text filter
findings.evidence: e2e/deep-coverage.spec.ts:68 uses page.locator('main button:not([disabled])').filter({ hasText: /افزودن به سبد خرید/ }).first(); ProductCard.tsx renders the text but no stable data-testid, so DOM-order changes (e.g. multiple cards) could pick the wrong button
findings.suggested_fix: Add data-testid='add-to-cart' to ProductCard/ProductDetail buttons and target that in the spec.

findings.title: Checkout submit located via partial aria-label match
findings.evidence: e2e/deep-coverage.spec.ts:194 uses page.locator('[aria-label*="ثبت نهایی سفارش"]'); actual element is CheckoutOrderSummary.tsx:111 aria-label="ثبت نهایی سفارش و انتقال به درگاه پرداخت امن" — works today via substring match but is positional/linguistically fragile
findings.suggested_fix: Add data-testid='checkout-submit' to CheckoutOrderSummary submit button and use it.

coverage_gaps: server/routes/upload.ts — no test file in tests/ (verified via grep -rl upload tests/)
server/routes/coupons-active.ts — no test file in tests/ (grep -rl 'coupons-active' tests/ returned nothing)
server/routes/blog.ts — no direct API test (only JSON-LD/sitemap/breadcrumb indirect coverage)

PROJECT_GRAPH.md section 4 lists tests/api (auth, admin, cart, products, orders, payment, reviews, users, coupons) — those all exist; the three routes above are the gap between routes present in server/routes/ and direct test coverage

e2e specs (deep-coverage, real-user, store) contain no broken selectors found: aria-label/title/role anchors verified against src/components/profile/AddressBookTab.tsx:185/196 and CheckoutOrderSummary.tsx:111; flagged items R4-04/R4-05 are fragility improvements, not breakage
